tools.name: Taskcluster pool replay
tools.description: Replay a mix of level-1 jobs into available worker-pool capacity.
tools.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Replaying tasks also needs Taskcluster credentials and scopes; see the tool's help.

tools.name: Taskcluster task creator
tools.description: Submit test tasks to a worker queue to check workers or run a custom command.
tools.prerequisites: Python 3 and Pipenv. Submitting tasks also needs Taskcluster credentials in ~/.tc_token with the required scopes.

tools.name: Fleetroll
tools.description: Audit and monitor Firefox CI hosts, and manage their Puppet configuration.
tools.prerequisites: Requires a launcher build with uv project support, uv, and Python 3.11+. Host operations also need SSH access and the credentials described in the documentation.
tools.note: Requires a launcher build with uv project support.
